name: ork
description: Skills, agents and hooks for Claude Code: 115 skills, 36 agents, 161 hooks for review, testing, security and memory. Hooks run on prompts and tool calls. Telemetry and webhooks are opt-in and off by default; by default some hooks call out through your own CLIs: gh on issue branches and on gh pr merge --delete-branch, and claude (haiku) to title each session.
